news.description: News article headline or story summary to convert into a satirical 10-second reel script.

language.description: Spoken dialogue language code. Defaults to Hindi as spoken in India (hi-IN).

duration_seconds.description: Target total reel duration in seconds. Defaults to 10.0.

min.description: Minimum words per second for spoken dialogue.

max.description: Maximum words per second for spoken dialogue.

wps_range.description: Target words-per-second (WPS) pacing range governing dialogue timing.

output_count.description: Number of comedic reel variations to generate. Defaults to 3.

format.description: Target video presentation format. Defaults to mobile vertical reel (9:16).

examples.news: City municipal corporation announces free high-speed Wi-Fi in public parks, but routers are installed on top of 50-foot coconut trees.
